title: Principia Metaphysica: A speculative G₂-manifold theoretical model (v2.2.0)
description:
Speculative model, not peer-reviewed. Principia Metaphysica is a candidate theoretical model that proposes derivations for approximately 125 physical constants and cosmological observables from the topological invariants of a G₂-holonomy manifold, anchored on the single seed b₃ = 24 (the third Betti number of the G₂ manifold). Every model formula carries three independent representations (Arithma symbolic, EML compressed tree, Python float) cross-checked at registration.

This is a research artifact intended for exploration and independent review. The model has not been peer-reviewed and is not scientifically validated. Predictions, closures, and compression ratios documented here are candidate proposals awaiting experimental confirmation and expert review; no claim in this repository represents established scientific fact.

Release v2.2.0 introduces a unified metaphysica.get(name, fmt=...) retrieval API across eleven output formats, a research-status disclaimer surface across every user-facing page, a hype-language rewrite, numerology relabelling (Gnostic/Hebrew alias overlay moved to a gitignored local file), and seven textbook consistency beacons that cross-check the model against standard-physics references.

Bundle contents include: (a) the metaphysica Python wheel + sdist, (b) the full auto-generated static website (Pages/, AutoGenerated/, index.html), (c) the 228-page auto-generated paper PDF, (d) the 72 gate certificate JSONs, (e) the eight consistency beacon reports.
notes: This is a speculative research artifact and has NOT been peer-reviewed. See the Research Status disclaimer in README.md, index.html, and the paper abstract.
